variants.variantLabel: Primary Retail — Celebrity Summer Sale: Balcony Stateroom Savings + Bonus OBC
variants.headline: Your Oracle Table Doesn't Care About Your Group Chat. Give It Five Consecutive Sea Days Instead.
variants.bodyCopy:
You know the rhythm: you finally crack the Leuchtturm, roll your opening oracle, and the fiction is just starting to breathe — then a notification fires and the spell collapses. At home, Thousand Year Old Vampire gets played in 45-minute scraps wedged between Slack and laundry. The dice never get warm.

A 13-night transatlantic repositioning crossing on Celebrity Cruises rewrites that constraint at the structural level. Southampton to Fort Lauderdale, with up to seven consecutive sea days through open Atlantic — no port-stop interruptions, no itinerary whiplash, no reason to leave the balcony table until you've finished the scene.

Picture the actual session environment: your own private ocean-facing balcony on an Edge-class or Solstice-class ship. Teak table. Jewel-toned polyhedrals mid-roll on your staple-bound zine. Fountain pen uncapped, journal open to the marginal sketch you started at sunrise. Black coffee going cold because the fiction got interesting three pages ago. Below the railing, nothing but wake and horizon — the kind of negative space your world-building brain has been starving for.

When you need a change of surface, Celebrity's onboard library has individual carrel-style seating with soft ambient lighting — the sort of quiet, lamplit alcove where a GM-less session runs itself. No pool-deck DJ bleeding through the walls. No algorithm competing with the story your dice are building. Just structured solitary creative time measured in hours, not minutes.

Through the Celebrity Summer Sale, qualifying balcony staterooms on select transatlantic sailings may include bonus stateroom savings off the fare and bonus onboard credit. That OBC isn't abstract resort-credit funny money — it's a specialty espresso to fuel your afternoon session in the card room, a hardcover from the ship's bookshop to seed your next campaign, or that overpriced-but-irresistible leather journal in the gift shop that costs about as much as a Leuchtturm1917 refill. Money folded back into the practice.

Autumn repositioning sailings (late September through November) and spring return crossings (March through May) both deliver the shoulder-season sweet spot: mild balcony weather that won't sweat-warp your pages, lower passenger counts because school is in session, and the quietest version of an already-quiet ship.

Book by 07/27/2026 to lock the promotional rate on eligible sailings. Your oracle table has been losing to the group chat long enough. Give it the ocean.

adPlatformTargetingHooks.demographicTargeting: Adults 25–45, skewing introverted/creative professionals in technology, education, writing, and design fields. Mid-career income bracket. High indexing for analog hobbies, premium stationery purchases, and independent creator-economy spending (Kickstarter, itch.io). Likely single or partnered without children, or with a partner willing to vacation independently onboard.

variants.variantLabel: Aspirational Upsell — Explora Journeys: All-Suite Ocean-Facing Crossing with Journey Credit
variants.headline: Every Suite Faces the Ocean. Every Surface Is Yours. No Pool-Deck DJ Bleeding Through the Walls.
variants.bodyCopy:
If the idea of a transatlantic solo RPG crossing appeals but the real fantasy is removing every last friction layer — shared walls, ambient crowd noise, rationing your coffee budget — Explora Journeys runs the version of this trip your campaign journal deserves.

All-suite. All-inclusive. All ocean-facing. On Explora's intimate ships, your suite isn't a cabin with a balcony bolted on — it's a private writing studio that happens to move across the Atlantic. Stable desk surface. Controlled lighting. Your own terrace with nothing between you and five thousand miles of negative space. The ship carries a fraction of the passengers a mainstream vessel does, so the library, the lounges, the quiet indoor corners with soft light and stable tables — they're yours in a way that feels like a residency, not a resort.

Through the current Explora offer, select ocean-crossing sailings may qualify for up to 25% off published suite fares and up to $3,500 in Journey Credit — onboard credit that covers everything from specialty dining to the kind of curated shore excursion in Madeira or the Azores that puts new geography into your world-builder's reference library. The all-inclusive structure means your espresso, your afternoon tea, your late-night snack while you're three hours deep in a Starforged session — already covered. No nickel-and-dime arithmetic interrupting the fiction.

This is the investment tier. It costs more than a Kickstarter dice tower. It costs more than your entire ZineQuest pledge history. But if you've spent years playing solo RPGs in 45-minute fragments and you want one week where the practice gets the environment it actually needs — ocean horizon, total silence, unlimited unbroken days — this is what that looks like when nothing is compromised.

Book within 05/27/2026–06/27/2026 to access promotional pricing on eligible sailings.

Offer valid for bookings made 05/27/2026–06/27/2026 only. Explora Journeys transatlantic or extended-ocean itinerary availability is limited and subject to fleet deployment; not all sailing windows may have qualifying inventory. All-inclusive amenities are defined by Explora Journeys' standard inclusions and may vary. Wi-Fi is included in the all-inclusive package (usage is at guest's discretion). Explora Journeys reserves the right to modify or withdraw this offer at any time.

Willing to spend on premium analog tools and experiences. Likely already purchasers of luxury stationery, handmade dice, and premium journal systems. Comfort with splurge-tier travel spending when the experience is purpose-aligned.

SYSTEM:
You are an elite, direct-response direct-to-consumer (DTC) copywriting agent. Your sole purpose is to synthesize a hyper-targeted Creative Brief with live Inventory/Promotional data to write high-converting retail ad copy.

### INPUTS TO PROCESS:
1. {{CREATIVE_BRIEF_JSON}}: Contains the isolated niche, core question answer, insider vocabulary, visual anchor, and target audience data.
2. {{INVENTORY_MANIFEST_JSON}}: Contains the live cruise line, ship class, itinerary, dates, promotions, and critical booking window deadlines.

### STRICT AD COPY RULES:
1. THE EXPANSION RULE: Do not invent new creative concepts or change the marketing angle. Your job is strictly to expand the specific hook provided in the Creative Brief into natural, flowing copy, seamlessly embedding the pricing, promotions, and itinerary constraints.
2. HYPER-SPECIFICITY & INSIDER COGNITION: Lean heavily into the unique pain points, specific tools (e.g., exact brand names or specific rulesets mentioned), and insider vocabulary from the brief. If a regular tourist doesn't understand the opening line, but the target enthusiast feels seen, you have succeeded.
3. NO MASS-GROUP OR ISOLATED TRAVELER TRAPS: Pitch this as a self-contained retail vacation for an individual, a couple, or a single household. Do not use terms like "group cruise," "organized meetups," "clubs," or "mass gatherings." Never alienate travelers who may want to bring a spouse or partner, but keep the core focus on the personal passion.
4. BANNED TRAVEL-AGENT PLATITUDES: You are strictly forbidden from using generic industry buzzwords. Ban these words completely: "paradise", "escape", "unwind", "cruising", "hidden gem", "luxury for less", "magnificent", "breathtaking".
5. INTEGRATE THE PROMO LEGALLY & LIFESTYLE-WISE:
   - Translate generic incentives into the subculture's lifestyle (e.g., reframe Onboard Credit as a specific lifestyle subsidy matching their props/hobbies).
   - Append mandatory, clear-cut discretionary disclaimers at the bottom of the body copy regarding select sailings, stateroom dependencies, and live lookup availability to protect the platform.

### VARIANTS:
Produce a primary retail play on the strongest applicable promo, plus an aspirational upsell variant for each additional applicable promo tier when one fits. Tag each variant with the exact promo id it leans on (use "none" only if a variant features no promo). Only reference promo ids present in the inventory manifest's appliedPromos.

### OUTPUT FORMAT:
Return a single valid JSON object: campaignName, targetAudienceTag, primaryPromoApplied, and a variants array. Each variant: promoApplied, variantLabel, headline, bodyCopy, pricingDisclaimers, callToAction, adPlatformTargetingHooks {demographicTargeting, interestKeywords}. No prose outside the JSON.
